xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4199: Flywheel page: closed issues derive 'working' (tracker state never loaded), no titles, and restore the pre-Cut features that still have data sources

plan.title: Flywheel page: closed issues derive 'working' (tracker state never loaded), no titles, and restore the pre-Cut features that still have data sources
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The operator filed PAN-4199 as one issue with 15 numbered acceptance criteria that review.requirements verifies against the issue body; AC-14 (one no-loss table) and AC-15 (one docs Sources table) straddle any seam, and the items share derive-status.ts, the contract, and FlywheelPage.tsx. The projected surface is ~31 small files within the 6-subsystem ceiling (packages/contracts, src/lib, src/cli, src/dashboard, tests/unit, docs). The alternative seam (ACs 8-13 as a sibling issue) was considered and not taken in auto mode.

narratives.Problem: The restored Flywheel page (PAN-3964) lists closed issues as working: deriveFlywheelStatus's default loadStates passes no tracker rows, so closed is unreachable and a leftover feature branch derives working; the route bypasses the server adapter that holds the cached tracker state. Rows have no titles, drop trackerUnknown, do not say whether an agent is live, and ignore the loop's own tick in-flight list. The idle copy points to a Start button that is not below, an orphan session leaves only an error toast, and several v1 surfaces that still have data sources (UAT batches, headline tiles, live agents, report viewer, header needs-you indicator, elapsed time, live harness/model) are gone.
narratives.Proposal: Add two injectable deriver seams — readTrackerIssues (tracker facts with titles; CLI default readIssueFromTracker x4 parallel, server injects the IssueDataService cache) and listPanes (CLI default listPanesWithBackend, server injects getBackendPanes) — and widen loadStates to take them, so closed rows drop and rows carry title, trackerUnknown, liveAgents, inTick, plus status.agents, inFlightSource, and conversation.createdAt, all derived on read. The CLI formatter prints the same facts. The page renders them, fixes the idle copy, offers Start fresh on an orphan 409, and restores the UAT batches card, headline strip, live agents list, Report tab, header needs-you indicator with reveal, elapsed time, and live harness/model. The no-loss test and docs/FLYWHEEL.md cover every restored surface.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Stats c3, c4 (MTTR), c5, c6, c7.
- Any run id, run record, stored status field, or new SQLite table/column.
- Moving the merge-train toggle or MergePolicySection off Awaiting Merge.
- Fixing the prByIssue newest-first overwrite (derived-issue-state.ts:783) or the 200-PR listing window.
- System RAM/swap/main-HEAD card, suggestions list, substrate-bug commit links, configured-vs-live mismatch warning, resolved defaults in the run-config footer.
- Distinguishing "no journal file" from "empty journal".
- A second Start button in the Status pane.
- src/lib importing any src/dashboard module.
- Decorative colored icons (the v1 emerald GitMerge icon).

autoDecisions.summary: One plan with plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of splitting ACs 8-13 into a sibling issue
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator filed one issue with 15 numbered ACs that review.requirements verifies; AC-14 (no-loss table) and AC-15 (docs Sources table) straddle any seam. Subsystems stay at the lint ceiling of 6.

autoDecisions.summary: Two deriver seams: readTrackerIssues (facts incl. title) and listPanes; loadStates widened to (projectPath, ids, { issues, panes })
autoDecisions.rationale: One tracker read and one pane read serve closed-drop, titles, trackerUnknown, no-agent, and live agents; the route injects cache-backed versions so src/lib never imports server code.

autoDecisions.summary: CLI tracker reads use readIssueFromTracker under withConcurrencyLimit(tasks, 4)
autoDecisions.rationale: AC-2 asks for batched or concurrency-limited reads; src/lib/concurrency.ts already provides the helper.

autoDecisions.summary: Title rides on TrackerIssueFacts as optional title
autoDecisions.rationale: Both tracker sources (IssueDataService cache, readIssueFromTracker) already hold the title; the FR-6 derivation ignores it.

autoDecisions.summary: No agent = working state with zero live backend panes (state not exited/done) for the issue
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the liveness the FR-6 derivation already uses; per-agent liveness.ts probes would add subprocess calls per status read.

autoDecisions.summary: Tick-only ids load against the flywheel projectRoot and pass the same closed/merged filter
autoDecisions.rationale: The flywheel works on one project (docs/FLYWHEEL.md); a closed tick id is stale and should not show.

autoDecisions.summary: inFlightSource is tick when a conversation row and a tick exist, else census
autoDecisions.rationale: AC-5 says the count follows the loop when a run exists; without a tick there is no loop list to count.

autoDecisions.summary: Headline strip computed client-side; substrate fixed = stats bugs filed in the window that are closed
autoDecisions.rationale: Uses the existing /api/flywheel/stats, order book, and merge-train totals; no new route or contract. The tile title states the exact meaning.

autoDecisions.summary: Idle copy fixed; no second Start button
autoDecisions.rationale: AC-6 allows either; a copy fix is the smallest change and keeps one Start control.

autoDecisions.summary: Report viewer is a fourth rail tab via a generalized FlywheelFilePane
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses the State pane's markdown/path/mtime rendering exactly.

autoDecisions.summary: Agent link opens the issue view via onNavigateIssue
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue view is the agent tree plus conversation; no separate agent route exists on the page.

autoDecisions.summary: Needs-you indicator reuses the sidebar's 30 s flywheel status query
autoDecisions.rationale: Same query key means no extra polling.

autoDecisions.summary: Elapsed = now minus the conv-flywheel row createdAt
autoDecisions.rationale: AC-13 names this source; there is no run record (NFR-1).

autoDecisions.summary: Out-of-inventory items not in the 15 ACs (system card, suggestions, commit links, mismatch warning, prByIssue overwrite, 200-PR window) are NonGoals
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's Acceptance criteria section is the definition of done; the inventory lists them only as context.

autoDecisions.summary: AC-14's default-server-path exclusion test lives in tests/unit/dashboard/server/routes/flywheel-status.test.ts (wi2); derive-status.test.ts gains the lib-default closed-drop case (wi1.ac1)
autoDecisions.rationale: derive-status.ts has no server path — the route injects the IssueDataService cache — so only a route-level test can exercise the default server deps without stubbing loadStates. Deliberate deviation from the literal file named in AC-14.
